meaning: Every YAML property a tool may write to a note. A property not listed here is a contract failure (testing: tools/importer/test/contract.test.ts). Relationship fields (a list of wiki links, relationships.yaml) are allowed without a row. Owner says who may change the value: bom, ea, person, tool. Owner values: bom, ea, person, tool, and "bom+person" for a value the BOM fills at import and a person may change afterwards. A row with `values` is a governed list: the value is one of them, and adding a value is a rules edit.

properties.name: type
properties.meaning: Class of the note (element-types.yaml).

properties.name: subtype
properties.meaning: Approved classification within the class.

properties.name: id
properties.meaning: PREFIX-NNNNN, never reused (MOD-020).
properties.source: Allocated by the importer or the template

properties.name: uid
properties.meaning: Permanent identity: creation time plus author code (MOD-019).
properties.source: Allocated by the importer or the template

properties.name: status
properties.meaning: Draft, Active, Retired.

properties.name: eaType
properties.meaning: EA stereotype or object type, temporary (MOD-035).

properties.name: tags
properties.meaning: Obsidian tags.

properties.name: name
properties.meaning: Current name of the note (MOD-171).

properties.name: aliases
properties.meaning: Other names: former names, EA Alias, abbreviations (MOD-172).

properties.name: partNumber
properties.meaning: Part number as exported, a string; the file name is this value made safe (MOD-170, MOD-173).

properties.name: description
properties.meaning: The BOM name or description of the part (BOM-016).

properties.name: jiraKey
properties.meaning: Key of the Jira ticket that approved the ECO (GOV-026). Approval, approver and date stay in Jira (GOV-027).

properties.name: jiraUrl
properties.meaning: Link to the Jira ticket (GOV-026).

properties.name: branch
properties.meaning: Name of the repository branch that brings the ECO in (GOV-026).

properties.name: bomCategory
properties.meaning: The category of a BOM part: the value of the optional `category` column in the BOM file (BOM-062) or, when there is none, the category from the words of the description by the ordered rules in tools/importer/src/bom_category.ts (BOM-041, BOM-063). "Uncategorized" when no rule matches.
properties.source: BOM category column or BOM description

properties.name: bomRole
properties.meaning: final (has child lines, no parent in the BOMs read), sub (both), part (no child lines, used somewhere), unused (neither).

properties.name: makeBuy
properties.meaning: Make or buy. Filled from the BOM `source` column (any other value or none is `other`, BOM-061); not the same as `sourcing`.

properties.name: level
properties.meaning: Level of a part: product is a top-level assembly. Filled from `bomRole` (`final` is product, `sub` is assembly, `part` and `unused` are part, BOM-042) (MOD-178).

properties.name: sourcing
properties.meaning: How the part is sourced: designed, standard hardware or off-the-shelf (MOD-178). Filled from the BOM where it can be; not the same as `makeBuy`. Spelling as written in MOD-178.
properties.source: BOM where available, else a person

properties.name: businessLine
properties.appliesTo: Part notes and elements a Part implements
properties.meaning: One business line; IPC when more than one line uses the part or assembly (MOD-188).

properties.name: sourceRole
properties.meaning: authoritative-model.

properties.name: primarySymbol
properties.meaning: Qualified SysML name of the note's main element.

properties.name: importSource
properties.meaning: File the BOM-owned content last came from (BOM-031).

properties.name: importedOn
properties.meaning: Date of the last BOM import or update.

properties.name: importHash
properties.meaning: Hash of the BOM-owned content (D-0050).

properties.name: bomOwns
properties.meaning: Areas the BOM still owns after a merge (BOM-036).

properties.name: abstract
properties.meaning: Abstract definition flag, written only when true.

properties.name: aliasOf
properties.meaning: Same part as another note, awaiting a merge (MOD-167).

properties.name: manufacturer<N>
properties.meaning: Manufacturer of the Nth source of the part (BOM-028).

properties.name: mfgPn<N>
properties.meaning: Manufacturer part number of the Nth source (BOM-028).
